metadata.question: On February 14, 2023, were nighttime lights in central Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, brighter than those around Hatay Airport?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime lights in two specific locations in Türkiye on February 14, 2023. I need to: 1. Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 or VNP46A1 collections) 2. Define two geometries: - Central Antakya (capital of Hatay Province) - Hatay Airport area 3. Get data for the specific date (Feb 14, 2023) 4. Compare brightness values between the two locations 5. Handle potential data issues (clouds, missing data) For nighttime lights, I'll use the VIIRS VNP46A2 collection which has the 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m' band. I'll need to mask poor quality pixels using the 'QF_Cloud_Mask' band. Let me define the geometries: - Central Antakya: Point around 36.1497°E, 36.2066°N with a buffer - Hatay Airport: Point around 36.2822°E, 36.3711°N with a buffer I need to check for data availability and handle the case where there might be no data or all pixels are masked. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometries const antakya = ee.Geometry.Point([36.1497, 36.2066]).buffer(2000); // Central Antakya const hatayAirport = ee.Geometry.Point([36.2822, 36.3711]).buffer(2000); // Hatay Airport area // Get VIIRS nighttime lights for Feb 14, 2023 const date = '2023-02-14'; const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(date, '2023-02-15'); // Check if collection is empty const count = viirs.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { print("No VIIRS data found for Feb 14, 2023"); print("C1"); return; } // Get the image and select avg_rad band const image = viirs.first(); // Calculate mean radiance for both regions const antakyaStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: antakya, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const airportStats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hatayAirport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const antakyaRad = antakyaStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const airportRad = airportStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Check for valid results if (antakyaRad === null || airportRad === null || isNaN(antakyaRad) || isNaN(airportRad)) { print("Invalid calculation results"); print("C3"); return; } // Print results and determine answer print(`Antakya radiance: ${antakyaRad.toFixed(2)}`); print(`Airport radiance: ${airportRad.toFixed(2)}`); print(`Antakya brighter: ${antakyaRad > airportRad}`); if (antakyaRad > airportRad) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
